Pixel OS v1.6.9 — 1:1 iOS 26 Notification Center, Zero Shade Glitching & True 3D Refractive Liquid Glass on Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Replaces left-half swipe-down with a 1:1 iOS 26 Liquid Glass Notification Center / Cover Sheet (88sp Liquid Glass clock + date, live NotificationListenerService squircle cards with swipe-to-clear & morphing Clear pill, Now Playing platter, and bottom Flashlight/Camera droplets)
• Eliminates Android vs iOS shade glitching everywhere via persistent StatusBarManager.disable(DISABLE_EXPAND) when unlocked, Z-layer 31 TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY windowing, and 90Hz finger-tracked Home Screen & top-bezel pull-downs (NexusLauncherRelease v17.6.9-ios26)
• Upgrades Control Center & Notification Center from flat blur to true 3D refractive iOS 26 Liquid Glass AGSL (S-curve meniscus lens prism over sharp 540x1200 wallpaper, RGB chromatic dispersion, TIR depth groove, top caustic, 135° specular rim wire, and exterior contact shadow)
• Fixes Settings -> General -> Software Update launch target (IosSettings v2.0.3-ios26) and adds GitHub CDN cache-busting in SamuraiOTAUpdater v1.5
